    U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(A, full_matrices=full_matrices)
    U, S, Vh = U[..., :k], S[..., :k], Vh[..., :k, :]
    result = U @ torch.diag_embed(S) @ Vh
    if out is not None:
        out.copy_(result)
        return out
    return result

def fused_bmm_rmsnorm_gelu_dropout(input1, input2, normalized_shape, dropout_p=0.1, eps=1e-5, training=True, approximate='none', *, out=None):
    result = torch.bmm(input1, input2)
    result = result / torch.sqrt(result.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    result = F.gelu(result, approximate=approximate)
    result = F.dropout(result, p=dropout_p, training=training)
    if out is not None:
        out.copy_(result)
        return out
    return result
